title: Finite localized splitting cover with maximal contractions and root witnesses
statement: Let R be a normal Nagata domain [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring] [def-weil-pbc-nagata-ring], K its fraction field, x in K, S=R[x], m a maximal ideal of S and A=S_m [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. There exist a normal Nagata domain Rprime, its fraction field Kprime, an element z of Kprime and a multiplicative subset M of T=Rprime[z] consisting of nonzero divisors, such that B=M^{-1}T admits an injective finite A-algebra map [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. For every maximal ideal q of B, the contraction n0 to T is maximal, and some r in Rprime satisfies z-r in n0. Rprime and Kprime are in Type(max u v) when R and K are in Type u and Type v. No normal-open or local-presentation conclusion is asserted.

proof.text: Fix $\mathfrak m$ and set $\mathfrak n=R\cap\mathfrak m$. The field $\kappa(\mathfrak m)$ is generated as a $\kappa(\mathfrak n)$-algebra by the residue of $x$, because $S=R[x]$; it is finite over $\kappa(\mathfrak n)$ by [lem-weil-pbc-zariski-lemma]. Let $\bar f(T)=T^d+\sum_{i=1}^d\bar c_iT^{d-i}\in\kappa(\mathfrak n)[T]$ be the monic minimal polynomial of the residue of $x$. Lift each $\bar c_i$ to a fraction $c_i/s_i\in R_{\mathfrak n}$ with $s_i\in R\setminus\mathfrak n$; localize $R$ and $S$ at the product $s=\prod_i s_i$, so all lifts lie in $R_s$. The resulting monic $f(T)\in R_s[T]$ has $f(x)\in\mathfrak mS_s$, since its residue in $\kappa(\mathfrak m)$ is $\bar f(\bar x)=0$. The maximal ideal $\mathfrak mS_s$ and its localization of $S$ still give the original $S_{\mathfrak m}$.

source.place: Tag 0334, proposition-nagata-universally-japanese, Step 5: residue-polynomial lifting, finite splitting extension, integral closure and roots over maximal ideals

proof.text: Work over the localized $R_s$ and rename it $R$. Adjoin roots of $f$ successively to $K$; at most $d$ finite algebraic extensions give a finite splitting field $K''/K$. Let $R'$ be the integral closure of $R$ in $K''$. The Nagata property of $R$ [lem-weil-pbc-nagata-localization] makes $R'$ a finite $R$-module by the N-2 clause of [def-weil-pbc-nagata-ring] and [def-weil-pbc-japanese-domain]; it is a normal domain with fraction field $K''$ by [lem-weil-pbc-integral-closure-finite-extension-normal], and Nagata by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-over-nagata-nagata]. Every root of the monic polynomial $f$ is integral over $R$, so lies in $R'$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure]. Put $S'=R'[x]\subset K''$. The same finitely many $R$-module generators of $R'$ generate $S'$ as an $S$-module, so $S\subseteq S'$ is finite [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], hence integral by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-algebra-is-integral].

proof.text: Let T=Rprime[z] in the splitting field L, and let M be the image of S minus m in T. This multiplicative subset avoids zero because all maps into L are injective. Set B=Localization M. After the denominator localization, T is finite over S_s, and s is already a unit in A=S_m. Localizing the finite extension therefore gives a finite injective map A to B. Every maximal ideal q of B contracts to the unique maximal ideal of the local ring A by integrality. Its contraction to T lies over the maximal ideal of S_s and is maximal by integrality of T over S_s. This proves the finite map, the nonzero-divisor condition on M and maximality of the contracted ideal.

source.place: Tag 0334, proposition-nagata-universally-japanese, Step 5: residue-polynomial lifting, finite splitting extension, integral closure and roots over maximal ideals

proof.text: For a maximal q of B, let n0 be its maximal contraction to T. The lifted polynomial evaluates at z into n0 and factors into linear terms z-r_i with r_i in Rprime. Its degree is positive, and a prime ideal containing the product contains one factor. Thus there exists r in Rprime such that z-r belongs to n0. This is the required root witness; shifting the generator and identifying the localizations are separate proved steps of the parent theorem.

theorem exists_adjoin_singleton_splitting_cover
    (R : Type u) (K : Type v) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K] (hR : IsNagataRing R) (x : K)
    (m : Ideal (Algebra.adjoin R ({x} : Set K))) [m.IsMaximal] :
    ∃ (R' K' : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing R') (_ : IsDomain R')
      (_ : IsIntegrallyClosed R') (_ : Field K') (_ : Algebra R' K')
      (_ : IsFractionRing R' K'),
      IsNagataRing R' ∧ ∃ (z : K') (M : Submonoid (Algebra.adjoin R' ({z} : Set K'))),
        M ≤ nonZeroDivisors (Algebra.adjoin R' ({z} : Set K')) ∧
        ∃ (_ : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime m) (Localization M)),
          Function.Injective (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime m) (Localization M)) ∧
          Module.Finite (Localization.AtPrime m) (Localization M) ∧
          ∀ (q : Ideal (Localization M)) [q.IsMaximal],
            (q.comap (algebraMap (Algebra.adjoin R' ({z} : Set K'))
              (Localization M))).IsMaximal ∧
            ∃ r : R',
              (⟨z, Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_singleton z)⟩ :
                Algebra.adjoin R' ({z} : Set K')) -
                algebraMap R' (Algebra.adjoin R' ({z} : Set K')) r ∈
                q.comap (algebraMap (Algebra.adjoin R' ({z} : Set K'))
                  (Localization M))
